[size=4]1. Soil Synthesizer[/size][/b]
[size=2]You tired to spend your hard earned fish on quality fertilizer and get nothing out of it?
So you running around and chop a bunch of trees for a handfull seeds?
And your always low on coral and calm and cant find enough clay?
Than you need the handy Soil Synthesizer.[/size]
[/b][/font][font=Arial][b]

[size=3]In Short: Uses coal and time to cheapen soil production in total.[/size]
[size=2]
Crafting Cost: 2 IronBars, 2 CopperBars, 4 Refined Quarz, 10 Clay[/size]

Recipes:[/b]
[size=2]
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]1 Sap ->  8 Basic Fertilizer  (80 min)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]1 Fish(any)  -> 12 Quality Fertilizer  (160 min)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]1 Stone -> 6 Basic Retaining Soil (80 min)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]1 Clay -> 8 Quality Retaining Soil (160 min)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]1 Pine Tar -> 8 Speed-Gro (320 min)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]1 Oak Resin -> 6 Deluxe Speed-Gro (480 min)[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Arial][b]
*Soil Synthesizer uses 1 coal per operaton.

[size=2][b]You use to have a lot of furnaces that eat your coal?

[size=3]
